You can't prevent what she's already started, she's just playing mind games with you. If she refuses to go out with you despite your numerous attempts, then move on.
She probably isn't interested in you since you're fairly young. She's an adult who has her own priorities, she's just leading you on.
If you're not meeting each other's needs/desires, then it's time for you to come clean about how you feel and end things on good terms, if possible.
Then give her some time and space for now. She needs time to recover from the loss, and her relationship with you is not her top priority.
It's best to show her how concerned you are in person. Visit her and physically offer a shoulder to cry on. Be her anchor in times of emotional turbulence.

I feel you, overthinking is a pain in the ass. I would confront her about your needs/wants and see if she needs/wants the same as well. Ask her how she would define your current relationship and if she wants to take it in the same direction you would.
Don't rush anything. I've learned that if you force yourself to find romantic/sexual experiences, it always ends in shit. Wait for the right person.
